newsitem.title: USA: Nine states join Alaska's bid to bar liquor ads.
newsitem.headline: Nine states join Alaska's bid to bar liquor ads.

text.p: Nine states have joined Alaska in petitioning the Federal Communications Commission to ban hard liquor advertisements from television and radio, Gov. Tony Knowles said Thursday.

In a filing with the FCC, Knowles said, Alaska Attorney General Bruce Botelho added as signatories to Alaska's petition the names of attorneys general from Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, Minnesota, Michigan, North Dakota, Rhode Island and Vermont, along with the director of commerce and consumer affairs for Hawaii.
Most Alaska television stations have declared they will refuse liquor advertisements, but local stations are unable to block advertising from national network programming, state officials said.
They said they are also worried liquor advertisements that may be on cable or satellite channels appearing in Alaska.
